in_marathi.name: Harmeeta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Female God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harmeeta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harmeeta is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Harini’, which means ‘female god of wealth’. In Hindu mythology, Harmeeta is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of wealth and abundance. Harmeeta is a name that symbolizes wealth, abundance, and prosperity.
